entry.name: accum
entry.digest: Store, add to, and multiply a number
entry.description: Stores a value (int or float), then adds or multiplies into it. If the argument is an integer, the multiplication is done in floating-point then converted to integer.

arguments.name: initial
arguments.description: Sets the initial value stored in. An argument with a decimal point causes the value to be stored as a float.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: In left inlet: Outputs the value currently stored in.

messages.name: float
messages.description: In left and middle inlet: Converted to, unlesshas a float argument.In right inlet: Multiplication is done with floats, even if the value is stored as an int.

messages.name: ft1
messages.digest: Add to the current value without triggering output
messages.description: In left inlet: The message, followed by a number, adds the number to the stored value without triggering output.

messages.name: in1
messages.digest: Add to the stored value with no output
messages.description: In middle inlet: The number is added to the stored value, without triggering output.

messages.name: in2
messages.digest: Multiply by stored value with no output
messages.description: In right inlet: The stored value is multiplied by the input, without triggering output.

messages.name: int
messages.description: In left inlet: Replaces the value stored in, and sends the new value out the outlet.

messages.name: set
messages.digest: Set the stored value with no output
messages.description: In left inlet: The word, followed by a number, sets the stored value to that number, without triggering output.

inlets.digest: int Sets and Outputs Value, bang Outputs Value
